0022600117.text: Detroit (1-0, first in the Central and second in the East) is in its third game of the season, while Philadelphia (2-0, first in the Atlantic and first in the East) is also unbeaten so far. The 76ers are without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently a 116-93 win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
